verdict.summary: KARAMTARA (38/100) — Reject / AVOID, and not merely for lack of data: the stock fails the Trend Template on five of eight criteria (c2 150>200 DMA, c3 rising 200 DMA, c4 50>150/200 DMA, c6 ≥30% above 52-week low, c8 RS ≥70), sits 15.4% below its 52-week high with all major moving averages collapsed onto a single value (~375, i.e. no separation, no uptrend), and 15.4% below its stated pivot of 444. Score 38 reflects that the base structure (3/20), sponsorship (0/5), RS/trend power (3/15) and leadership (0/5) contribute next to nothing. The one genuine positive is fundamental: EPS annual growth 64% and 3-yr EPS CAGR ~73% on 3-yr sales CAGR ~39%, ROE 20.8%, ROCE 23.4%, zero pledge, and OCF/PAT of 2.88x over three years. But that is exactly the 'interesting company, wrong stage' case the framework rejects, and the fundamentals themselves have holes: latest-quarter net margin contracted ~77 bps YoY, interest coverage of 3.5x fails the 5x bar, share count grew 10.3% in two years, and reported FCF is -₹247 cr in the latest period. No actionable setup exists.
strengths: Earnings trajectory is the standout: annual EPS grown to 7.83 (64.2% latest YoY) with 3-yr EPS CAGR ~73.5%
Revenue scaling alongside profit: 3-yr sales CAGR ~39.2%, latest quarterly sales YoY +79.4%, B1 full marks (6/6)
Cash generation: 3-yr cumulative OCF/PAT of 2.88x (C3 full marks)
Zero promoter pledge, and promoter holding 82.0% indicates high skin-in-the-game
weaknesses: Fails Trend Template on c2, c3, c4, c6 and c8 — the 50/150/200 DMAs are effectively a single flat line at ~375, i.e. no defined uptrend
Price 15.4% below the 52-week high and only 17.4% above the 52-week low — fails the ≥30%-above-low criterion
RS percentile unverified and therefore scored 0 (F1), so the single most important Minervini ranking input is absent
Base structure weak (3/20): 4.6 weeks in base, 23.7% depth, 6.79% weekly-close tightness, price 15.4% below pivot
Sponsorship 0/5 — institutional holding data is a single data point (6.81%), so no rising trend can be established; no marquee-holder confirmation
Quality cracks: latest-quarter net margin contracted ~77 bps YoY (C2 = 0), interest coverage only 3.5x, share count +10.3% over two years (D3 = 0)
Reported FCF negative at -₹247 cr with zero positive FCF years counted (C4 = 0)
Thirteen fields unverified, including RS percentile, base count, industry-group RS and traded value — the analysis is materially data-incomplete
verdict.biggest_risk: Buying a fundamentally improving but technically broken stock: with all three major moving averages flattened at ~375 and price 15.4% below the 444 pivot, any entry here is a bet against the trend with no defined stop structure — the framework's downside case is dead money or further base erosion while waiting for an unconfirmed Stage 2.
